lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The pattern forms a semi-regular grid with 3 to 5 nodes per column in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes where the blobs are centered on the vertical stripe trajectories.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper flank is visible, defined by a high-contrast luminance gradient with light pixels on the dorsal side and a shadow-induced low-luminance zone on the ventral side.
